title: SWE-rebench V2: Language-Agnostic SWE Task Collection at Scale
authors_zh: Ibragim Badertdinov, Maksim Nekrashevich, Anton Shevtsov, Alexander Golubev
paper_type_zh: 软件工程任务数据发布、构造配方与可执行智能体环境
best_for_zh: 研究仓库智能体训练、RLVR、软件工程环境构造与测试型 verifier 审计的读者
one_line: SWE-rebench V2 releases 32,079 prebuilt, test-verifiable repository repair environments across 20 languages plus 126,300 PR-derived training tasks, built by an automated setup, oracle-extraction, LLM-filtering, and metadata pipeline.
SWE-rebench V2 发布 32,079 个跨 20 种语言的预构建可执行仓库修复环境及 126,300 个 PR 衍生训练任务，并公开测试终态反馈与自动构造配方，但不可变回放、污染、权利与失败记录仍不完整。
why: It exposes the environment and terminal test contract needed to turn real repository changes into post-training tasks, while also surfacing the parser, specification, licensing, and replay risks that determine whether those tasks are trustworthy learning signals.
inclusion_reason: A multilingual, training-oriented release that makes repository task records, Docker execution environments, F2P/P2P terminal feedback, automated setup and parser synthesis, conservative LLM filtering, and diagnostic risk metadata inspectable at substantially larger scale than manually curated SWE benchmarks.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The primary sources for this Card are arXiv 2602.23866v2 (revised 1 June 2026), the official ICML 2026 poster record, the pinned official GitHub repository, and the two official Hugging Face releases. The work addresses a training-data bottleneck rather than only proposing another SWE leaderboard: repository agents need many task specifications paired with reproducible code states, executable tests, and terminal feedback, while manually curated SWE benchmarks are smaller and concentrated in a few high-resource ecosystems.

The main released object is a repository-repair task/environment row. It binds a problem_statement to repo, base_commit, the historical gold patch, test_patch, FAIL_TO_PASS, PASS_TO_PASS, install_config, language, repository license metadata, diagnostic meta, and, for the issue-linked release, a prebuilt image_name. A downstream episode starts from the repository at base_commit; an agent interacts with that state and submits a candidate patch, after which the Docker environment supplies full-suite test observations and a terminal success decision. The release does not contain the agent's state/action/observation trajectory or the seven-model diagnostic trajectories.

The arXiv v2/main Hugging Face release contains 32,079 executable issue-linked tasks from 3,617 repositories across 20 programming languages, all in one train split and with prebuilt images. The separate PR-derived release contains 126,300 rows in its current official Hugging Face revision; the paper describes this tier as 120,000+ tasks and does not provide prebuilt images for it. The official ICML page retains older figures of 36,000+ tasks, 3,800+ repositories, and 100,000+ PR tasks, so this Card treats the discrepancy as release drift and uses the pinned v2/Hugging Face counts for the current artifacts.

This is an anchor for environment_agent_trajectory_data because it exposes a resettable task state, environment recipe, executable feedback, and full-episode terminal predicate, even though trajectories must be generated downstream. It also belongs to data_construction_open_release_recipes because task mining, setup synthesis, parser synthesis, executable filtering, LLM clarity filtering, and release packaging are central contributions. Its L4 content is supported by the full paper, appendices, dataset schemas, licenses, and evaluator code; the unexposed harvesting implementation, immutable environment manifest, contamination audit, and failure corpus remain explicit unknowns.

本卡的主要来源是 2026 年 6 月 1 日修订的 arXiv 2602.23866v2、ICML 2026 官方 poster 条目、固定到 commit 的官方 GitHub 仓库，以及两个 Hugging Face 官方发布。该工作解决的重点不是再增加一个 SWE 排行榜，而是训练数据瓶颈：仓库智能体需要大量任务说明，并且每条任务都要绑定可复现的代码状态、可执行测试与终态反馈；人工整理的 SWE benchmark 规模更小，也更集中于少数高资源生态。

主发布的数据对象是一条仓库修复任务/环境记录。它把 problem_statement 与 repo、base_commit、历史 gold patch、test_patch、FAIL_TO_PASS、PASS_TO_PASS、install_config、编程语言、仓库许可证元数据、诊断性 meta 绑定；issue-linked 发布还提供预构建 image_name。下游 episode 从 base_commit 的仓库状态开始，智能体与该状态交互并提交 candidate patch，随后 Docker 环境返回全测试集观测与终态成功判定。官方发布不包含智能体的 state/action/observation 轨迹，也不包含七个模型的诊断轨迹。

arXiv v2 与主 Hugging Face 发布包含 32,079 个可执行 issue-linked 任务，覆盖 3,617 个仓库和 20 种编程语言；数据只有一个 train split，并提供预构建镜像。独立的 PR-derived 发布在当前 Hugging Face revision 中有 126,300 条记录；论文将该层描述为 120,000+ 个任务，且这一层不提供预构建镜像。ICML 官方页面仍保留 36,000+ 个任务、3,800+ 个仓库和 100,000+ 个 PR 任务的旧数字，因此本卡把差异记录为 release drift，并以固定版本的 v2/Hugging Face 数量描述当前 artifact。

该工作是 environment_agent_trajectory_data 的锚点，因为它公开了可重置任务状态、环境配方、可执行反馈和完整 episode 的 terminal predicate，尽管轨迹必须由下游另行生成。它也属于 data_construction_open_release_recipes，因为任务挖掘、setup 合成、parser 合成、可执行性筛选、LLM 清晰度筛选与发布打包都是核心贡献。本卡的 L4 内容由论文全文、附录、数据 schema、许可证和 evaluator 代码支撑；未公开的完整 harvesting 实现、不可变环境 manifest、污染审计与失败语料仍明确保持 unknown。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The contribution is a language-agnostic factory for turning public repository history into training-oriented executable repair environments, with repository-specific setup and test parsing synthesized automatically and each surviving task paired with a terminal test contract. The paper's unit of scale is therefore not merely an issue prompt: it is a task row plus a repository state and enough environment metadata to execute a submitted patch.

The feedback contract has two distinct layers. During construction, the pipeline applies the test_patch, runs the repository's full suite before the solution, then applies the historical solution patch and reruns the full suite; tests changing from fail to pass become F2P, while tests expected to stay passing become P2P. At evaluation time, the released Docker evaluator applies a candidate patch and the test_patch, runs install_config.test_cmd, parses the final log into PASSED/FAILED/SKIPPED test states, and sets passed_match only when the normalized passed-test set exactly equals PASS_TO_PASS + FAIL_TO_PASS. It also reports unrecovered F2P tests and regressed P2P tests.

This programmatic/environmental verifier can observe patch application, process exit, parser-visible test identities, and the expected F2P/P2P terminal state. It cannot establish semantic equivalence to the historical fix, maintainability, security, specification completeness, behavior not exercised by tests, or whether a generated parser silently omitted a test. The separate gpt-oss-120b, GLM-4.7, and DeepSeek-V3.2 ensemble filters issue clarity; it is a conservative construction judge, not the terminal correctness oracle and not human verification of every row.

Relative to SWE-bench-style manually curated evaluation sets, SWE-rebench V2 shifts emphasis toward automated training-scale collection across 20 languages, reusable per-repository setup, synthesized log parsers, and two release tiers. Relative to an ordinary benchmark, its central value is the exposed data-construction and environment contract. Existing ingredients—GitHub issue/PR history, Docker, F2P/P2P tests, mini-SWE-agent, and LLM judges—remain identifiable; the contribution is their integration and scaling into inspectable task releases, not invention of each component.

其核心贡献是一条语言无关的任务工厂：把公开仓库历史转成面向训练的可执行修复环境，自动合成仓库特定的 setup 与测试 parser，并让每个保留任务都带有终态测试契约。因此，论文扩展的单位不只是 issue prompt，而是任务记录、仓库状态，以及足以执行提交 patch 的环境元数据。

反馈契约有两个层次。构造阶段先应用 test_patch，在 solution 之前运行仓库全测试集；随后应用历史 solution patch 并再次运行全测试集。由失败转为通过的测试成为 F2P，预期持续通过的测试成为 P2P。评测阶段，官方 Docker evaluator 应用 candidate patch 与 test_patch，运行 install_config.test_cmd，把最终日志解析成 PASSED/FAILED/SKIPPED 测试状态；只有归一化后的通过测试集合与 PASS_TO_PASS + FAIL_TO_PASS 完全相等时，才把 passed_match 设为真。报告还分别列出未恢复的 F2P 与发生回归的 P2P 测试。

这个 programmatic/environmental verifier 能观察 patch 是否应用、进程退出状态、parser 可见的测试标识，以及预期 F2P/P2P 终态；它不能证明 candidate patch 与历史修复语义等价、代码可维护或安全、问题说明完整、未被测试覆盖的行为正确，也不能发现生成 parser 静默漏掉的测试。独立的 gpt-oss-120b、GLM-4.7 与 DeepSeek-V3.2 ensemble 负责筛选 issue 清晰度；它是保守的构造 judge，不是终态正确性 oracle，也不是逐条人工核验。

相较 SWE-bench 风格的人工整理评测集，SWE-rebench V2 把重点转向跨 20 种语言的自动化训练规模采集、可复用的逐仓库 setup、合成日志 parser 和两级发布。相较普通 benchmark，其核心价值是公开的数据构造与环境契约。GitHub issue/PR 历史、Docker、F2P/P2P 测试、mini-SWE-agent 和 LLM judges 都是已有组件；这里的变化是把它们整合并扩展为可检查的任务发布，而不是声称逐一发明这些组件。

title: Method
方法
html:
Inputs are public GitHub Archive issue/PR activity, cloned repository histories, issue descriptions, PR discussions, commit SHAs, diffs, test changes, license labels, activity statistics, and primary-language metadata. Candidate repositories must have a permissive license; candidates require a resolved issue, a merged PR, and a PR that changes tests. High-resource ecosystems use thresholds of 25 stars and 15 closed issues, while long-tail ecosystems use 10 stars and one closed issue. A case-insensitive (?i)(test(?:ing|s)?|e2e) heuristic separates test files from the non-test solution patch, with inline-test pathologies annotated later. (Paper §3.1; Appendix A.1)

Environment construction first asks Qwen3-Coder-480B-A35B-Instruct to generate language base Dockerfiles. Then mini-SWE-agent v1.14.4, backed by the same model, inspects each repository, installs dependencies, runs tests, and emits repository-level install and test scripts. The production collection uses one setup attempt per repository. Qwen3-Coder-480B-A35B-Instruct also synthesizes a repository-specific Python log parser mapping raw test output to test-name → PASSED/FAILED/SKIPPED; parser regeneration is capped at five iterations. One successful setup is reused across tasks from that repository. (Paper §§3.2, 4.1; Appendix A.2–A.3)

Executable validation applies test_patch at base_commit, runs the full suite, then applies the historical solution patch and reruns the full suite. A candidate survives only when setup and parsing work and at least one test changes from fail to pass. The pipeline then sends issue text independently to gpt-oss-120b, GLM-4.7, and DeepSeek-V3.2 and retains the instance only under unanimous adequacy. gpt-oss-120b adds difficulty, PR categories, A/B pathology codes, confidence, external-URL and test-alignment notes; another prompt extracts the interface exercised by the tests. The paper prompt defines B1–B7, while the current main Hugging Face schema exposes B1–B6.

The larger PR-derived branch reuses successful repository setups for PRs without linked issues. It generates a problem statement from the PR description and gold patch, then applies a refined prompt and post-processing intended to reduce solution leakage. The PR problem generator, interface generator, decoding parameters, exact suspicious-leakage detector, threshold, rejection counts, and measured leakage rate are unknown. Its current release has 126,300 train rows and install/F2P/P2P metadata but no top-level prebuilt image field.

For downstream evaluation or RLVR, the official evaluator starts the task image, applies a submitted patch and test_patch, executes the full-suite test_cmd, and reduces the final parsed state to passed_match plus F2P/P2P diagnostics. Supervision attaches to the completed repair episode; no step labels, shaped reward, or released action trace are provided. The authors propose agent training, test-reward RL/RL warm-up, SFT subset selection, and evaluation, but the paper trains no agent and contains no data-training ablation.

Reproduction must pin arXiv v2, code commit c71902a8cf8d2b725f63d51f199f4d3e56f68d2d, main dataset revision 475dd5e8703bb5fb22dd3c60b5d038b019eba1e0, and PR dataset revision 40faf2c1bb160de625f3c3270ac9d62ea45f3f9c. It should additionally pin OCI digests, dependency snapshots, parser and runner versions, network/timeout policy, and task split. The repository has neither a tag nor a GitHub Release and does not expose the complete GitHub Archive harvesting/distributed collection implementation.

输入来自公开 GitHub Archive issue/PR 活动、克隆后的仓库历史、issue 描述、PR 讨论、commit SHA、diff、测试改动、许可证标签、活跃度统计和主要编程语言元数据。候选仓库必须采用宽松许可证；候选任务必须对应已解决 issue、已合并 PR，并且该 PR 修改测试。高资源生态的阈值为 25 stars 与 15 个已关闭 issue，长尾生态为 10 stars 与 1 个已关闭 issue。系统用大小写不敏感的 (?i)(test(?:ing|s)?|e2e) 启发式区分测试文件与非测试 solution patch，并在后续标注 inline-test 病理。（论文 §3.1；附录 A.1）

环境构造首先让 Qwen3-Coder-480B-A35B-Instruct 生成语言 base Dockerfile。随后 mini-SWE-agent v1.14.4 以同一模型为后端，检查仓库、安装依赖、运行测试，并输出仓库级安装与测试脚本。主采集对每个仓库只进行一次生产 setup 尝试。Qwen3-Coder-480B-A35B-Instruct 还合成仓库特定的 Python 日志 parser，把原始测试输出映射成 test-name → PASSED/FAILED/SKIPPED；parser 最多重新生成五轮。同一仓库的多个任务复用一次成功 setup。（论文 §§3.2、4.1；附录 A.2–A.3）

可执行验证从 base_commit 开始应用 test_patch 并运行全测试集，再应用历史 solution patch 并重新运行全测试集。只有 setup 与解析成功、且至少一个测试由失败转为通过的候选才进入下一步。之后系统把 issue 文本分别交给 gpt-oss-120b、GLM-4.7 和 DeepSeek-V3.2，三者一致认为说明充分时才保留。gpt-oss-120b 补充难度、PR 类别、A/B 病理代码、置信度、外部 URL 和测试对齐说明；另一条 prompt 抽取测试覆盖的 interface。论文 prompt 定义 B1–B7，而当前主 Hugging Face schema 只暴露 B1–B6。

更大的 PR-derived 分支面向没有关联 issue、但所在仓库已有成功 setup 的 PR。它根据 PR 描述与 gold patch 生成 problem statement，再用改进 prompt 与 post-processing 尝试减少 solution leakage。PR 问题生成器、interface 生成器、解码参数、可疑泄漏 detector、阈值、拒绝数量和实测泄漏率均为 unknown。当前发布包含 126,300 条 train 记录和安装/F2P/P2P 元数据，但没有顶层预构建 image 字段。

用于下游评测或 RLVR 时，官方 evaluator 启动任务镜像，应用提交 patch 与 test_patch，执行全测试集 test_cmd，再把最终解析状态归约为 passed_match 以及 F2P/P2P 诊断。监督附着于完整修复 episode；没有逐步标签、shaped reward 或公开 action trace。作者把数据定位于 agent training、test-reward RL/RL warm-up、SFT 子集选择与评测，但论文没有训练智能体，也没有数据训练消融。

复现必须固定 arXiv v2、代码 commit c71902a8cf8d2b725f63d51f199f4d3e56f68d2d、主数据 revision 475dd5e8703bb5fb22dd3c60b5d038b019eba1e0 和 PR 数据 revision 40faf2c1bb160de625f3c3270ac9d62ea45f3f9c。还应固定 OCI digest、依赖 snapshot、parser/runner 版本、网络与 timeout 策略及任务划分。官方仓库没有 tag 或 GitHub Release，也没有公开完整的 GitHub Archive harvesting 与分布式采集实现。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The construction funnel is the strongest scale evidence. From 29,511,758 PRs in 145,306 repositories, the pipeline finds 8,593,722 PRs changing tests, 805,598 issue-linked test-changing PRs, 583,809 candidates after repository filtering, 41,349 tasks with successful F2P extraction, and 32,079 tasks after issue-text filtering. The resulting main release spans 3,617 repositories and 20 languages; tasks date from 2014–2025, with median patch size of three files/34 lines and 90th percentile of nine files/181 lines. These are author-reported pipeline and release statistics, not a row-level quality certificate. (Paper §§3.6–3.7, Table 1)

The setup ablation covers 103 tasks/repositories across ten languages. With Qwen3-Coder-480B-A35B-Instruct under mini-SWE-agent, the paper reports pass@1 of 25.8 at a 32k budget and pass@10 of 62.7 at 128k; the non-interactive setup baseline reports pass@1 of 12.1. This supports the value of closed-loop setup and retries under those budgets, while the production pipeline still uses one attempt per repository. (Paper §4.1, Table 2; Appendix A.1, Table 8)

The issue-clarity ensemble is calibrated on 1,699 SWE-bench Verified instances with three human annotations. For the Verified-E target, the reported precision/recall/F1 is 0.83/0.10/0.17; for mixed consensus it is 0.88/0.06/0.11. The filter is therefore conservative and high-precision under this calibration but discards many acceptable specifications; unanimous acceptance is not equivalent to human verification of the released 32,079 rows. (Paper §4.2, Tables 3 and 5)

The diagnostic study samples 300 tasks—60 each in Python, JavaScript, Go, Rust, and Scala—and runs seven models three times per task. Table 6 reports aggregate pass@1 25.2 and pass@3 32.7 for Claude Opus-4.5; Appendix C rounds these to 25% and 33%. The analysis identifies restrictive test coupling, implicit naming requirements, and external dependencies. It characterizes model behavior and task confounders on this subset, but does not validate every row or show that training on the release improves an agent. (Paper §4.3, Table 6; Appendix C)

Artifact evidence is independently inspectable: the main Hugging Face split has 32,079 rows and the PR split has 126,300; the official code contains prompts, base Dockerfiles, image builders, generated parsers, and scripts/eval.py. The ICML abstract's older 36,000+/3,800+/100,000+ counts conflict with arXiv v2 and current release counts. This version drift, absence of a tagged release, and absence of training ablations limit what the benchmark-style numbers can establish.

最直接的规模证据来自构造漏斗：29,511,758 个 PR、145,306 个仓库，缩减为 8,593,722 个修改测试的 PR、805,598 个关联 issue 且修改测试的 PR、583,809 个仓库筛选后候选、41,349 个成功抽取 F2P 的任务，最终经过 issue 文本筛选得到 32,079 个任务。主发布覆盖 3,617 个仓库和 20 种语言，任务时间为 2014–2025；patch 中位数为 3 个文件/34 行，90 分位为 9 个文件/181 行。这些是作者报告的 pipeline 与发布统计，不是逐条质量证书。（论文 §§3.6–3.7，表 1）

setup 消融覆盖 10 种语言的 103 个任务/仓库。Qwen3-Coder-480B-A35B-Instruct 在 mini-SWE-agent 下，以 32k budget 报告 pass@1 25.8，以 128k 报告 pass@10 62.7；非交互 setup baseline 的 pass@1 为 12.1。这支持 closed-loop setup 与重试在对应 budget 下的价值，但主生产 pipeline 仍只对每个仓库尝试一次。（论文 §4.1，表 2；附录 A.1，表 8）

issue 清晰度 ensemble 在 1,699 个带三份人工标注的 SWE-bench Verified 实例上校准。对 Verified-E 目标，precision/recall/F1 报告为 0.83/0.10/0.17；对 mixed consensus 则为 0.88/0.06/0.11。因此该筛选在此校准下保守且 precision 较高，但会丢弃大量可接受说明；三模型一致接受不等于对 32,079 条发布记录逐条人工验证。（论文 §4.2，表 3 与表 5）

诊断研究抽取 300 个任务——Python、JavaScript、Go、Rust、Scala 各 60 个——让七个模型对每个任务独立运行三次。表 6 报告 Claude Opus-4.5 的汇总 pass@1 为 25.2、pass@3 为 32.7；附录 C 将其四舍五入为 25% 与 33%。分析还识别出过度限制的测试耦合、隐式命名要求与外部依赖。它只刻画该子集上的模型行为和任务混杂因素，不能验证每条记录，也没有证明用该发布训练会提升智能体。（论文 §4.3，表 6；附录 C）

artifact 证据可独立检查：主 Hugging Face split 有 32,079 条，PR split 有 126,300 条；官方代码包含 prompts、base Dockerfile、镜像 builder、生成 parser 和 scripts/eval.py。ICML 摘要中较旧的 36,000+/3,800+/100,000+ 与 arXiv v2 及当前发布数量冲突。该版本漂移、缺少 tagged release，以及缺少训练消融，共同限制了 benchmark 式数字能支持的结论。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The prior baseline is a landscape of relatively small, manually curated SWE evaluation sets and training collections concentrated in high-resource languages. SWE-rebench V2 changes the target from a benchmark-only instance to a training-oriented environment record assembled automatically from repository history and executable repository behavior. Its main release joins task text, base commit, gold/test patches, F2P/P2P expectations, install/test recipe, parser, metadata, and a prebuilt image at 32,079-task scale across 20 languages.

The construction novelty is the reusable repository-level setup coupled to repository-specific parser synthesis. Instead of requiring a hand-authored environment for every task, one interactive setup agent generates install/test procedures once per repository; full-suite pre/post validation extracts the oracle; a three-model clarity ensemble filters specifications; and diagnostic metadata flags likely test/specification problems. The PR branch then trades prebuilt execution for scale, releasing 126,300 additional task rows whose problem statements are generated from PR material.

This matters directionally for reasoning-data research because environment creation, feedback extraction, and metadata enrichment become explicit construction layers that can be ablated independently. It provides a concrete route from public software history to full-episode test feedback suitable in principle for agent RLVR, while preserving enough fields to study parser noise, test coupling, language coverage, and task selection. It is more accurately classified as a data release, construction recipe, and agent environment than as a generic benchmark.

The work does not introduce GitHub mining, Docker execution, unit-test reward, F2P/P2P semantics, mini-SWE-agent, LLM-as-judge filtering, or generated task descriptions individually. Much of the contribution is scale and systems integration. Scale alone is not a quality signal: reuse still requires parser audits, immutable environment pinning, rights and contamination review, leakage measurement for generated PR statements, and a training ablation that isolates the data contribution.

先前基线主要是规模较小、人工整理的软件工程评测集，以及集中于高资源语言的训练集合。SWE-rebench V2 把目标从纯 benchmark 实例改成由仓库历史与可执行仓库行为自动组装的训练型环境记录。其主发布在跨 20 种语言、32,079 个任务的规模上，把任务文本、base commit、gold/test patch、F2P/P2P 预期、安装/测试配方、parser、元数据与预构建镜像连接起来。

构造层的具体变化是把可复用的仓库级 setup 与仓库特定 parser 合成结合起来。它不再为每个任务人工编写环境，而是让交互式 setup agent 对每个仓库生成一次安装/测试流程；通过修复前后的全测试集验证抽取 oracle；用三模型清晰度 ensemble 筛选说明；再以诊断元数据标记潜在测试/规格问题。PR 分支则用较低的预构建执行完整度换取规模，额外发布 126,300 条由 PR 材料生成 problem statement 的任务记录。

其方向意义在于把环境创建、反馈抽取与元数据增强拆成可独立消融的 reasoning-data 构造层。它给出了从公共软件历史生成完整 episode 测试反馈的具体路径，原则上可服务 agent RLVR；同时保留足够字段来研究 parser 噪声、测试耦合、语言覆盖与任务选择。将其归为数据发布、构造配方与智能体环境，比归为泛化 benchmark 更准确。

该工作并未分别发明 GitHub mining、Docker 执行、unit-test reward、F2P/P2P 语义、mini-SWE-agent、LLM-as-judge 筛选或生成式任务描述；贡献中相当一部分是规模扩展与系统整合。规模本身不是质量信号：复用前仍需审计 parser、固定不可变环境、检查权利与污染、测量 PR 生成说明的泄漏，并通过训练消融隔离数据贡献。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• The single linux/amd64 container design excludes tasks requiring multiple services, databases, or external infrastructure. Even within one container, the released evaluator uses Docker host networking, supplies no explicit subprocess timeout, and depends on external resources that can drift. The public image template also wraps individual install commands with || true, so a built image does not by itself certify a successful setup.
  • Terminal reward is only as sound as the repository tests and generated parser. Tests may impose requirements absent from the issue, P2P may couple a task to unrelated behavior, and parsers may omit, merge, or rename tests. Exact passed-set equality detects parser-visible F2P/P2P outcomes but not semantic equivalence, maintainability, security, or untested regressions; reward hacking and verifier gaming therefore remain possible.
  • Unanimous LLM clarity filtering has high reported precision but very low recall on SWE-bench Verified calibration. It is not row-level human review and may preferentially retain specifications that match the three judges' shared biases. The paper prompt defines B7 while the main release schema exposes B1–B6, and the PR meta schema contains irregular legacy fields.
  • Both Hugging Face releases expose only a train split. Broad duplicate removal, overlap with existing SWE benchmarks, model-pretraining contamination, issue/PR leakage, and train/evaluation separation are unknown. For PR-derived task text, the leakage detector, threshold, rejection count, and measured residual rate are not disclosed.
  • The public repository releases prompts, builders, parsers, and evaluation utilities, but not the complete GitHub Archive mining/join/distributed harvesting implementation or a complete production setup-agent orchestrator. There is no Git tag or GitHub Release, and task rows do not provide verified OCI digests, dependency lock snapshots, or a complete immutable image manifest.
  • The funnel retains successful executable and clarity-approved tasks; raw failed setups, rejected candidates, parser failures, judge disagreements, and seven-model diagnostic trajectories are not released. Their contents and complete rejection counts are unknown, preventing analysis of selection bias and failed-episode learning.
  • Code is MIT and both dataset cards declare CC BY 4.0, but each source repository's license still applies. Compatibility for dependencies, tests, issues, PR contributions, and contributor rights is not fully audited. Public GitHub provenance also does not settle privacy: the sensitive-information rule, audit results, consent, deletion process, and retained-PII assessment are unknown.
  • The paper proposes SFT, test-reward RL/RL warm-up, curriculum selection, and agent training, yet reports no training ablation. Its diagnostic evaluation cannot establish training-data value. ICML, arXiv v2, and Hugging Face counts also differ, so unpinned reuse can silently change the claimed dataset.

• 单一 linux/amd64 container 设计排除了需要多服务、数据库或外部基础设施的任务。即使在单容器内，官方 evaluator 也使用 Docker host networking，没有显式 subprocess timeout，并依赖可能漂移的外部资源。公开镜像模板还用 || true 包裹单条安装命令，因此镜像成功构建本身不能认证 setup 成功。
  • 终态 reward 的可靠性取决于仓库测试与生成 parser。测试可能施加 issue 中没有的要求，P2P 可能把任务与无关行为耦合，parser 也可能遗漏、合并或改名测试。通过集合精确相等只能识别 parser 可见的 F2P/P2P 终态，不能证明语义等价、可维护性、安全性或未测试回归，因此 reward hacking 与 verifier gaming 仍可能发生。
  • 三个 LLM 一致通过的清晰度筛选在 SWE-bench Verified 校准中 precision 较高、recall 极低。它不是逐条人工审核，也可能偏向三位 judge 共同偏好的规格表达。论文 prompt 定义 B7，而主发布 schema 只暴露 B1–B6；PR 的 meta schema 还包含不规则 legacy 字段。
  • 两个 Hugging Face 发布都只有一个 train split。大范围去重、与已有 SWE benchmark 的重叠、模型预训练污染、issue/PR 泄漏，以及训练/评测隔离均为 unknown。对 PR-derived 任务文本，泄漏 detector、阈值、拒绝数量与实测残留率未披露。
  • 公开仓库发布了 prompts、builders、parsers 与评测工具，但未发布完整的 GitHub Archive mining/join/分布式 harvesting 实现，也缺少完整的生产 setup-agent orchestrator。项目没有 Git tag 或 GitHub Release；任务记录也不提供已核验 OCI digest、依赖 lock snapshot 或完整不可变镜像 manifest。
  • 构造漏斗只保留可执行成功且清晰度通过的任务；原始失败 setup、被拒候选、parser 失败、judge 分歧与七模型诊断轨迹均未发布。其内容与完整拒绝数量为 unknown，因而无法分析 selection bias 或利用失败 episode 学习。
  • 代码采用 MIT，两个 dataset card 声明 CC BY 4.0，但每条来源仓库的许可证仍然适用。依赖、测试、issue、PR 贡献及 contributor rights 的兼容性没有完整审计。公开 GitHub 来源也不能解决隐私问题：敏感信息规则、审计结果、同意机制、删除流程和保留 PII 评估均为 unknown。
  • 论文提出 SFT、test-reward RL/RL warm-up、curriculum selection 与 agent training，却没有报告训练消融；诊断评测不能建立训练数据价值。ICML、arXiv v2 与 Hugging Face 数量还存在差异，未固定版本的复用会让所称数据集静默变化。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For environment_agent_trajectory_data, the reusable object is an episode substrate rather than a trajectory corpus: initialize the repository at base_commit, expose the task statement and tools, collect state/action/observation events downstream, and attach the final parser-derived F2P/P2P outcome to the complete patch episode. A training pipeline should never reinterpret the released historical gold patch as an observed agent trace.

For agent RLVR, the main 32,079-row release can provide terminal binary reward after a submitted patch, while unrecovered F2P and regressed P2P lists support failure diagnosis or cautiously designed partial rewards. Before online training, builders should freeze images by OCI digest, disable or record network access, add timeouts, validate parsers against raw logs, and isolate held-out tasks. The official release does not demonstrate that this reward produces a training gain.

For SFT and curriculum work, the task statement, gold patch, interface description, difficulty, and pathology metadata can support supervised repair examples or subset selection. Such reuse is conditional rather than automatically safe: PR-generated statements need leakage review, gold patches and tests need rights checks, source and benchmark overlap must be measured, and no official train/validation/test separation protects evaluation.

For data_construction_open_release_recipes, the paper is a concrete blueprint for repository mining, reusable setup synthesis, parser generation, pre/post full-suite oracle extraction, clarity filtering, and diagnostic enrichment. Useful controlled experiments include varying setup retries, comparing parsers with hand-labeled logs, replacing unanimous LLM filtering with calibrated human/LLM mixtures, and quantifying how each filter changes language and repository coverage.

Version-pinned rows and environments are useful for evaluation and verifier audits, but the current main release should be treated as conditional training reuse and the PR tier as requiring additional environment reconstruction. Unqualified training reuse is blocked pending immutable replay, overlap/contamination, rights, privacy, leakage, and failure-retention audits. The paper remains directly useful as a construction recipe and audit reference even where those checks are incomplete.

对 environment_agent_trajectory_data 而言，可复用对象是 episode substrate，而不是轨迹语料：把仓库初始化到 base_commit，向智能体暴露任务说明与工具，在下游收集 state/action/observation 事件，并把 parser 计算出的 F2P/P2P 终态附着于完整 patch episode。训练管线不能把发布的历史 gold patch 误当作已观测的智能体轨迹。

用于 agent RLVR 时，主发布的 32,079 条记录可以在提交 patch 后提供二值终态 reward；未恢复 F2P 与回归 P2P 列表可用于失败诊断，或谨慎设计 partial reward。在线训练前应使用 OCI digest 固定镜像、禁用或记录网络访问、增加 timeout、以原始日志校验 parser，并隔离 held-out 任务。官方发布没有证明该 reward 会带来训练收益。

用于 SFT 与 curriculum 时，任务说明、gold patch、interface 描述、难度和病理元数据可形成监督修复示例或支持子集选择。但这种复用是有条件的，并非自动安全：PR 生成说明需要泄漏审计，gold patch 与测试需要权利检查，来源与 benchmark 重叠需要测量，而且官方没有 train/validation/test 隔离来保护评测。

对 data_construction_open_release_recipes 而言，论文给出了仓库 mining、可复用 setup 合成、parser 生成、修复前后全测试集 oracle 抽取、清晰度筛选与诊断增强的具体蓝图。可执行对照包括改变 setup 重试次数、用人工标注日志校验 parser、以经校准的人类/LLM 混合替代三模型一致筛选，以及量化每个 filter 对语言与仓库覆盖的影响。

固定版本的任务与环境可用于评测和 verifier 审计，但当前主发布应视为有条件的训练复用，PR 层还需要额外重建环境。在完成不可变回放、重叠/污染、权利、隐私、泄漏与失败保留审计前，不应进行无条件训练复用。即使这些检查未完成，该工作仍可直接作为构造配方与审计参考。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Remember the two release tiers: 32,079 issue-linked tasks with prebuilt images across 20 languages/3,617 repositories, versus 126,300 PR-derived rows whose paper-level description is 120,000+ and whose release has no top-level prebuilt image field.
  • Read Paper §§3.1–3.6 and Appendix A.3 together with pinned scripts/eval.py: construction-time pre/post full-suite validation and runtime exact F2P/P2P passed-set matching are related but distinct stages.
  • Do not call the release a trajectory corpus. It releases task/environment rows and terminal feedback; downstream agents must generate trajectories, and the seven-model diagnostic trajectories are unavailable.
  • Interpret Tables 2, 3, 5, and 6 as setup, filter-calibration, and diagnostic evidence under stated budgets—not as proof of record-level data quality or downstream training value.
  • Reuse only after pinning code/Hugging Face revisions and checking missing harvesting code, OCI digests, parser correctness, split/overlap, PR leakage, layered MIT/CC BY 4.0/source rights, privacy controls, and rejected/failure artifacts.

• 先记住两级发布：主层是跨 20 种语言、3,617 个仓库且带预构建镜像的 32,079 个 issue-linked 任务；PR 层当前为 126,300 条，论文称 120,000+，发布 schema 没有顶层预构建 image 字段。
  • 应把论文 §§3.1–3.6、附录 A.3 与固定版本的 scripts/eval.py 对照阅读：构造期修复前/后全测试集验证，与运行期 F2P/P2P 通过集合精确匹配，是相关但不同的阶段。
  • 不要把该发布称为轨迹语料。它公开任务/环境记录与终态反馈；轨迹必须由下游智能体生成，七模型诊断轨迹也未发布。
  • 表 2、3、5、6 分别提供指定 budget 下的 setup、筛选校准与诊断证据，不能作为逐记录数据质量或下游训练价值的证明。
  • 复用前必须固定代码/Hugging Face revision，并检查缺失 harvesting 代码、OCI digest、parser 正确性、split/重叠、PR 泄漏、MIT/CC BY 4.0/来源权利分层、隐私控制及被拒/失败 artifact。
